scenarios.name: validator_receipts_an_accepted_event
scenarios.note: A validator's receipt of an accepted inception, signed with the keys of the validator's inception, is stored; the same receipt again changes nothing.

scenarios.name: receipt_before_both_events
scenarios.note: A validator's receipt arrives before the receipted event and before the validator's own inception. It waits for the receipted event, then for the validator's, and is stored once both are accepted.

scenarios.name: receipt_before_the_validator
scenarios.note: A validator's receipt of an accepted event arrives before the validator's inception; it waits, and is stored once the inception is accepted.

scenarios.name: receipts_keripy_refuses_or_skips
scenarios.note: Validator receipts naming another event than the validator's at that number, or an interaction, which has no keys, or a key position past the validator's keys, are refused; one whose signature fails is skipped.

scenarios.name: receipts_from_a_rotated_validator
scenarios.note: A validator that has rotated receipts the same event twice: once signed with the keys of its inception, naming the inception, and once with its rotated keys, naming the rotation. Both are stored.

scenarios.name: quadruples_attached_to_events
scenarios.note: Events carry validator receipt quadruples. One from a known validator is stored with the event; one from a validator not seen yet waits and is stored once its inception is accepted; one whose signature fails is dropped. Each event is accepted whatever becomes of its quadruples.
